ayuda_texto: Open the meeting draft. Review the agenda and proposed decisions; each one shows its agenda item. You can download the original file. Check the approved and signed minutes to confirm what happened.
archivo_pista: Select the meeting draft you downloaded when preparing it. Maximum 4 MiB.
limite: Draft minutes for review. Check the approved and signed minutes to confirm the meeting.
vacio: Open a meeting draft to review the proposals.
cargado: Draft opened. Review the proposals and the outstanding checks.
cargado_cotejo_declarado: Draft opened. Check the panel preparation and that it is current before continuing.
descarga_lista: Original file ready to download. Check the approved minutes to confirm the meeting and decisions.
error_tamano: The file is empty or exceeds 4 MiB. Select a smaller one.
error_formato: The file could not be opened. Select the draft downloaded when preparing the meeting.
error_catalogo: The screen text could not be loaded. Reload the screen before opening a file.
idioma_respaldo: The selected language could not be loaded. An available language is shown and the file remains open.
idioma_error: The language could not be changed. The current language and open file have been kept. Try again.
sesion_limite: The agenda and decisions are proposals. Check the approved minutes to confirm the meeting and decisions.
fase_pendiente: Proposed · Phase membership still needs checking
fase_cotejo_declarado: Stage stated in the file · Confirmation pending
agenda_limite: Texts prepared for a proposed session. Item numbers link each agenda item to its proposed agreements.
agenda_vacio: There are no proposed agenda items. Complete the agenda and prepare another draft.
acuerdos_limite: These texts are not adopted agreements or board decisions.
acuerdos_vacio: There are no proposed decisions. Complete them and prepare another draft.
referencias_limite: Check the cited documents and panel preparation before continuing.
referencias_limite_cotejo_declarado: The file says it was compared with the panel preparation. Check that the preparation is still current.

motivos.antecedente_no_cotejado: Compare the draft with the original panel preparation before continuing.
motivos.antecedente_cotejado_local: The file says it matches the panel preparation. Check who issued it and whether it is still current.
motivos.pertenencia_no_verificada: Check that the phase belongs to the stated process and board. The proposed reference does not establish this.
motivos.fase_cotejada_local: Confirm the current stage and that panel members may act.
motivos.circuito_pendiente: The minutes still require review and signature through the appropriate procedure.
motivos.material_ausente: Complete this detail and prepare another draft.
